name: A regular
prompt: A regular at the counter wants her hash browns the way the old cook made them. Nobody wrote down how.

outcome.told: She eats them. She doesn't say anything about them either way.

choices.text: Ask her questions and try to get them right

outcome.told: Extra onion, cooked dark, pressed flat. She nods at you on her way out.

failure.told: She sends them back twice. The third time she says they'll do.
